sentences.text: The data show 12 pollinator visits on 17 May 2024 and 8 visits on 18 May 2024, but the rows do not attribute the difference to rain.
sentences.quote: Controlled rows: 17 May 2024, Maya, Riverside, 12 visits, 10 minutes; 18 May, 8 visits, 10 minutes. Rows do not attribute a difference to rain.

sentences.text: It is unknown whether rain caused the lower pollinator count because current notes do not resolve if rain changed pollinator activity or only prevented observation.
sentences.quote: Did rain change pollinator activity or only prevent observation? Current notes do not resolve this causal question.

sentences.text: The claim that rain reduced pollinator activity is speculative and not established by the interrupted visit or the two rows of data.
sentences.quote: Speculative causal explanation, not established by the interrupted visit or the two rows. Distinguish missing observations from fewer insects.

sentences.text: One observation of 12 visits on 17 May 2024 does not establish a trend, and a later wet visit was interrupted, limiting evidence.
sentences.quote: Maya recorded 12 pollinator visits in ten minutes on 17 May 2024 at Riverside. One observation does not establish a trend. A later wet visit was interrupted.
